HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.title: Blast
HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.description: Blasted creatures take damage at the end of their turn. Each turn, [gold]Blast[/gold] is reduced by half.
HADESANCIENTS-BLAST_POWER.smartDescripti: At the end of {OnPlayer:your turn, take|its turn, takes} [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage, then reduce [gold]Blast[/gold] by [blue]{HalfAmount}[/blue].
